shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && echo '---' && cat tsconfig.json && echo '---' && cat next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "for f in pages/404.js pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js pages/blog/[id].js pages/api/posts/index.js pages/api/posts/[id].js components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css; do echo '###' "'$f; sed -n '"'1,220p' "'$f; echo; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p app/blog/[id] app/blog app/api/posts/[id] app/api/posts app && mkdir -p lib types'
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"declare function headers|export declare function headers|function headers\\(\" node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' | head -n 20"

/bin/bash -lc 'rm pages/404.js pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/api/posts/[id].js pages/api/posts/index.js pages/blog/[id].js pages/blog/index.js pages/index.js && rmdir pages/api/posts pages/api pages/blog pages'

/bin/bash -lc "for f in app/blog/[id]/BackButton.tsx app/blog/[id]/page.tsx app/blog/page.tsx app/error.tsx app/global-error.tsx app/layout.tsx app/not-found.tsx app/page.tsx components/AppProvider.tsx tsconfig.json; do echo '###' "'$f; sed -n '"'1,120p' "'$f; echo; done'

/bin/bash -lc "for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/blog/page.tsx app/blog/[id]/page.tsx app/blog/[id]/BackButton.tsx app/not-found.tsx app/error.tsx app/global-error.tsx app/api/posts/route.ts app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts components/AppProvider.tsx lib/posts.ts types/posts.ts styles/globals.css next-env.d.ts; do echo '###' "'$f; sed -n '"'1,220p' "'$f; echo; done'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' app/api/posts/route.ts && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts && echo '---' && sed -n '1,260p' app/blog/[id]/page.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/layout.tsx | sed -n '1,220p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,240p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/blog/page.tsx | sed -n '1,240p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/blog/[id]/page.tsx | sed -n '1,320p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/blog/[id]/BackButton.tsx | sed -n '1,160p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/not-found.tsx | sed -n '1,220p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/error.tsx | sed -n '1,220p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/global-error.tsx | sed -n '1,240p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/api/posts/route.ts | sed -n '1,260p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts | sed -n '1,300p' && echo '---' && nl -ba components/AppProvider.tsx | sed -n '1,240p' && echo '---' && nl -ba lib/posts.ts | sed -n '1,240p' && echo '---' && nl -ba types/posts.ts | sed -n '1,220p' && echo '---' && nl -ba styles/globals.css | sed -n '1,320p' && echo '---' && nl -ba next-env.d.ts | sed -n '1,120p' && echo '---' && nl -ba tsconfig.json | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/blog/[id]/page.tsx | sed -n '1,260p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/api/posts/route.ts | sed -n '1,260p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts | sed -n '1,260p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/error.tsx | sed -n '1,220p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/not-found.tsx | sed -n '1,220p' && echo '---' && nl -ba app/global-error.tsx | sed -n '1,220p' && echo '---' && nl -ba components/AppProvider.tsx | sed -n '1,220p'"
